title: Canon of the Starfall
summary: A canon on calling starlight down from above in bolts and showers and last in one great descent upon the field.

title: Treatise of the Astrolabe
summary: A treatise on reading the whole field by starlight as by an astrolabe and lending that sight and strength to an ally.

title: Manual of the Supernova Heart
summary: A manual on swelling the qi at the heart to a blinding peak and loosing all of it in one burst.

title: The Stardust Canon
summary: A canon of the Azure Sky halls on breaking the body into stardust that blinds and shrouds and reforms elsewhere.

title: The Beacon Oath Discipline
summary: A discipline of the Gale oath-schools on kindling a beacon of starlight that guides allies and flares at the foe.

title: Treatise of the Wayfinder's Star
summary: A treatise on steering by one fixed star so that the user crosses the field in a single bright leap.

title: The Gnomon Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the long shadow of the gnomon that fixes the foe's weakest point and lands one blow upon it.

title: The Zodiac Wheel Manual
summary: A manual of the great wheel of twelve houses of starlight that turns across the field and throws every foe from his course.
